findings.name: Internet-facing API without rate limiting
findings.description: The public payments API has no rate-limiting control.
findings.scenario: An external attacker sends high-volume automated requests to bypass authentication controls.
findings.remediation: Implement API rate limiting and anomaly detection.

findings.name: PII stored without encryption at rest
findings.description: Customer PII data assets have no encryption-at-rest control.
findings.scenario: A compromised database credential exposes unencrypted PII of EU customers.
findings.remediation: Enforce AES-256 encryption for all PII data assets.

findings.name: Third-party payment processor without exit plan
findings.description: Critical dependency on payment processor lacks documented exit strategy.
findings.scenario: Third-party provider discontinues service with no fallback route available.
findings.remediation: Document and test exit strategy for payment processor dependency.

findings.name: GenAI fraud detection model producing biased decisions
findings.description: The GenAI fraud scoring model lacks bias monitoring.
findings.scenario: GenAI model exhibits discriminatory patterns in fraud scoring for protected groups.
findings.remediation: Implement bias monitoring and model explainability controls.
